summary: Hotfix backport: receive admission lends the writer in budgeted loans (128 envelopes or 250 ms, yielding to queued foreground writes) and defers admission after 10 s with a durable resume cursor; deferred receives still apply repairs and one projection chunk.

replay.detail: Stored envelopes and receipts are unchanged; a deferred receive resumes from a local cursor and never re-admits an envelope.

schema.detail: The resume cursor, receipt epoch and completed epoch are local values in the existing meta table; no table or index changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: No request or response fields change. Old senders may re-offer a deferred page, and receipt deduplication keeps that idempotent. This hotfix omits receive summaries and pending-envelope/last-page gauges.

recovery.detail: Rolling back leaves unused local cursor and epoch values; the previous hotfix admits any remaining pending envelopes as before.
